title: 九成代码AI写，谁来审？Claude Code亮出6道关卡！
content: Claude Code uses an AI-assisted, six-layer code review pipeline to manage surging AI-generated code, reducing rollbacks by over 40% compared to a doubled PR volume. This system integrates automated tests, independent AI review, security checks, and manual risk-based approvals. It mitigates AI review limitations through strict iteration limits and feature-flag releases. A dedicated feedback loop continuously validates detection accuracy, ensuring that human responsibility remains focused on high-risk judgments and accountability rather than line-by-line inspection.

title: 2岁幼童被开水烫伤后去世，无偿照看者遭索赔116万、最终赔偿15万元，为何这也要担责？法律上如何分析？
content: In Hohhot, a court ruled that Ni, who was voluntarily caring for a two-year-old child, compensated the child's mother 150,000 yuan after the toddler died from scalding injuries. The child fell over a boiling kettle and Ni initially delayed seeking medical attention. The court determined Ni failed to meet the necessary duty of care, causing liability. However, given the gratuitous nature of the assistance and lack of malicious intent, the compensation was significantly reduced from the 1.16 million yuan originally claimed by the parents.

content: Baidu’s third search redesign redefines its platform from query-based linking to task-based AI delivery, generating complete solutions like itineraries or financial alerts. This strategic pivot reflects a broader industry challenge where AI search reduces traditional traffic value.

This model effectively addresses the resource bottlenecks limiting US infrastructure growth.

content: A researcher identified a secret list of 100,000 words within the iOS system, including political nicknames. The feature modifies the keyboard’s behavior by preventing these terms from appearing in autocomplete suggestions or being reliably recognized during swipe input. This mechanism does not censor user content, as individuals can still manually type any text into emails or messages. However, the system actively withholds recommendations for the listed terms. Legal experts have criticized the discovery, describing the underlying functionality as unsettling and concerning.
